issues.on_page: Other local receipts 613,091.10 (General 22,439.85, Bond 297,806.86, Other Governmental Funds 292,844.39)
issues.issue: The statement's fund columns print the breakdown: the 292,844.39 Other Governmental Funds part is activity and nutrition sales, which Exhibit B (p2) shows as charges for services under Other student support. That is 47.8%, under the more-than-half rule, so 'other' is allowed. Splitting by fund column (split_from) would make about half of this line charges for services/fees.
